speed: n/a (locked frame; she supplies all the speed by running through it)
start_frame: From the brick-vaulted middle of the passage back toward the dark landing chamber: Alice small, out on the leaf heap, staring after him — the waistcoat-pocket, the watch.
end_frame: The same frame as she comes at camera out of the black and clears it low and close, leaves flying off her skirt, leaving the empty lit vault behind her.
constraint_honoured: 'The only fast shot in the scene' — the speed is hers; the camera stays put so her arrival at the lens is what accelerates the scene.
movement_note: A follow here would flatten the burst; letting her cross the whole depth of a fixed wide is the cheapest and most stable way to generate speed.
